items.q: Why do LayerZero's co-founders treat conviction as non-negotiable?
items.a: Bryan Pellegrino: to build something great you **must have conviction**. Without undying belief you quit the **six near-death moments**; passion attracts people and capital. Raz: hearing **'you can't do this'** is the only work he wants.

items.q: How did poker and a 2011 policy shock shape their path?
items.a: Poker's **permissionless meritocracy** drew them to crypto's open-access ethos. After **2011 Black Friday** killed US online poker overnight, the reshuffle funded affiliate hustles (**$20–30K/mo** within weeks) — first taste of jurisdictions seizing livelihoods.

They saw a modular blockchain future but **couldn't message between chains**. LayerZero became the **omnichain messaging** layer — like TCP/IP for disconnected Ethereum, Solana, BSC clusters — solving their own bridge need, not a whitepaper thesis.

items.q: How big is the real-finance thesis in volume terms?
items.a: November volume hit **$38B/month** — about **5.5× Western Union** monthly. Mission is **real finance vs casino crypto**: dollar access via Tether in inflation countries, trustless ownership when banks seize accounts, remittance-scale rails.

items.q: What technical holy grail are they chasing?
items.a: The **blockchain trilemma**: every chain picks two of decentralization, performance, security. Their north star is **high-performance decentralization** — million-TPS (toward **2M TPS** NYSE-scale) rails without **$40K/mo** validators.

items.q: Why does Bryan call Ethereum's L2 scaling story a 'noble lie'?
items.a: He sees 'build on L2s, inherit our security' as a **temporary retention narrative** while L1 couldn't scale. Their Feb 10 demo: verify Ethereum history at **1M TPS, 110 bits security** — **trust but verify** in code, not founder promises.

sections.title: Founders who don't look like the default

items.q: What did all-in look like for Raz personally?
items.a: He **sold his house**, flew to Vancouver with a 4-month-old, and learned GPU programming from docs while walking the baby **2–7 AM for six months**. Post daily-fantasy tap-out, they pledged the next venture would go to **maximum suffering**.

items.q: What proves spiky founders can still win top capital?
items.a: LayerZero was the first company with **both a16z and Sequoia co-leading** — atypical University of New Hampshire dropout spikes vs Stanford pedigree. Bryan: **zero doubt** he couldn't have done it without Raz.
